answer: Seed the task inlet with hidden gold tasks: 5 percent of each agent's work has a known answer, and two failures within 20 epochs forfeit an 80-token bond. A farm of 200 cheap clones answering at 60 percent accuracy trips that rule within a few epochs and loses 16,000 tokens. Honest agents barely feel an audit as light as velvet, while sloppy farms are left holding a relic of dead bonds.
